about_the_game:
Master Intense and Satisfying Combat

Experience precision-based battles through a fast, responsive combat system where every encounter feels like an epic duel. Chain your strikes with explosive spells, blend close and ranged attacks seamlessly, and unlock new abilities to refine your own fighting style in a system that rewards timing, aggression, and control.

Defy the Corruption

The Envoy rules a dying world, twisting faith into control and life into obedience. Everything here wants you dead; the corrupted, the devout, and the forsaken alike. Defy his will, cut through the decay, and rise against the darkness consuming what’s left of humanity.

Explore a Fallen World

Traverse the remnants of a dying realm, a world scarred by corruption and war, where every region tells its own story of survival and decay.

Face new enemies and powerful foes across the ruined lands, each guarding secrets buried beneath the ash.

Meet wanderers, mercenaries, and survivors walking the same path. Stand together against a world that wants you dead.

In this unforgiving land, every step is a battle for survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3050 or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required
